purpose: Step-1 metadata lock for cardiac transcriptomic validation. This file locks cohort eligibility, biological-unit grouping, study-family boundaries, and explicit exclusions. Raw matrices are acquired and hashed only after this metadata lock.

lock_policy.inclusion: Only publicly deposited cardiac transcriptomic cohorts with explicit condition metadata and defensible biological-unit grouping are included.
lock_policy.biological_unit: A biological unit is the independently sampled animal/heart/declared biological replicate. Cells or sequencing libraries are never independent biological units by default.
lock_policy.technical_replicates: Technical or paired libraries are nested under one biological unit.
lock_policy.pooled_libraries: Pooled-heart/litter libraries are not represented as individual animals and are excluded from the strict biological-replicate benchmark.
lock_policy.study_family: A complete experimental program is held out as one family; accession count is never substituted for biological independence.
lock_policy.raw_data_lock: This artifact does not claim raw matrices are downloaded or hashed. Those operations require a separate acquisition step.

strict_biological_replicate_benchmark.design: 5 sham + 5 MI at each of D2, D4, D7
3 sham + 3 MI day 7 + 3 MI day 28; nine 8-week-old male C57BL/6JR mice
4 sham + 4 MI; adult mice; tissue collected 2 weeks after surgery
vehicle-only subset: 3 sham + 3 MI; weekly prednisone arms excluded
4 sham-operated control samples + 3 MI samples at day 4; each sample has its own GEO/BioSample/SRA record.
strict_biological_replicate_benchmark.data_scale_warning: GEO supplementary processed values are FPKM; the strict count-model bundle must acquire raw SRA reads or a genuine raw-count matrix and must not use FPKM as negative-binomial input.

specialized_cellular_validation.design: 4 healthy + 4 seven-day MI adult mouse hearts; FACS-sorted cardiac endothelial cells
specialized_cellular_validation.benchmark_role: endothelial injury/cell-state validation, not whole-heart representation benchmark

specialized_cellular_validation.design: 18 single-nucleus MI samples: Day0 (3), 1HR (2), 4HR (1), Day1 (6), Day3 (3), Day7 (3); GEO explicitly labels the listed records as biological replicates where applicable.
specialized_cellular_validation.benchmark_role: temporal and anatomical validation; not primary sham-vs-MI benchmark because the snRNA component is MI-focused

excluded_from_strict_lock.reason: Primary paper reports pooling of 8–12 ventricular samples from the same litter before library preparation; library is therefore a pooled biological unit, not an individual animal.
Neonatal P1/P8 MI/sham experiment uses pooled ventricular tissue across multiple hearts for the sequencing libraries; it is not an individual-animal replicate dataset.

56 GEO libraries are present, but the current public metadata inspected here does not establish a complete GSM→animal mapping robustly enough for a strict biological-unit lock. No animal identity is inferred from sample-name strings.
excluded_from_strict_lock.use: regeneration/large-mammal contextual validation after explicit animal mapping is recovered

excluded_from_strict_lock.reason: Human CITE-seq is valuable, but exact heart/donor↔GEO-library mapping and paired GEX/ADT relationships must be reconciled before strict patient-level locking.
excluded_from_strict_lock.use: human translational validation after complete source reconciliation

excluded_from_strict_lock.reason: Removed from strict lock because the public evidence inspected here did not establish the relationship between multiple library labels and the declared biological replicates strongly enough for a fail-closed lock.
excluded_from_strict_lock.use: do not use until explicit library-to-biological-unit mapping is recovered

excluded_from_strict_lock.reason: Biologically valuable porcine regeneration cohort, but one inspected GEO record is internally inconsistent: GSM3186878 title identifies Pig_1763 while its characteristics field identifies individual Pig_1659. This source-level contradiction prevents automatic strict locking; no correction is inferred.
excluded_from_strict_lock.use: retain as quarantined regeneration reference until all 36 records are reconciled manually against source tables/publication

cohort_accounting.note: The unit total is an inventory count across studies, not a claim that all units are exchangeable observations. Study, species, timepoint, tissue, and assay remain explicit factors. Raw count acquisition and QC remain mandatory before model training.

before_raw_lock: download raw/processed expression from the accession-specific GEO/SRA source
record SHA-256 for every source file
verify expression identifiers against the accession sample list
verify one biological-unit-to-library mapping and record any technical-library nesting
verify count-scale semantics before negative-binomial training; transformed FPKM/TPM values are not acceptable model inputs
run structural, library-size, detected-gene, mitochondrial/ribosomal, doublet/ambient-RNA where applicable, and biological-replicate QC before benchmarking
run cross-study gene-identifier reconciliation without one-to-many mappings
preserve study_family_id so related experiments cannot cross benchmark partitions
acquisition_requirements.fail_closed: Any mismatch, missing file, ambiguous biological-unit relationship, or unexpected expression scale blocks the cohort from the locked analysis set.
